source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Picking this unit to shoot in your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) lets you pay 1 **Pain token** to make it [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain). If [Empowered](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain) after shooting, it marks one enemy unit hit by its attacks. **MONSTERS** and **VEHICLES** are ineligible. The mark imposes −2 **Move** and −2 on **Charge** rolls, expiring when your next turn begins.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

selection.trigger: after source unit shoots while Empowered
